verdict.rationale: Penpot does not document a native prompt-to-design feature. Instead, its official MCP server lets an external AI agent of your choice read and create design structures in Penpot files ("connect to Penpot MCP and prompt away", "generating editable design structures", "creating high-fidelity artifacts"). Prompt-driven generation and editing is therefore possible, but only through a third-party agent or LLM you bring and configure, and the evidence is vendor claims only. Missing for 10: built-in in-app prompt-to-design generation, documented examples of first drafts, layouts or full mockups being produced, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
